title: Vercel skips preview builds for branches with no open pull request, so only ready PRs take the single build slot

source.ref: owner 2026-10-06 19:43Z 'yo WTF' (a hung Domain Connect preview held the slot 28 minutes with the LIVE-690 production deploy queued behind it); coordinator: make only previews for ready PRs build

detail:
FILED AND CLOSED 2026-10-06. HYG-166 skipped drafts and superseded pushes, but threads push a branch before they open its pull request, and a branch with no open PR still built (launch and LIVE branches on 2026-10-06). decideQueue now also skips a PREVIEW when the pulls API returns no open PR for the branch. Production never takes the rule, and an unreadable GitHub (null) still builds. Two misses remain outside the script: a branch that has not brought main in runs its own older copy of the ignore step, and a hung build holds the single slot until Vercel's own timeout.

EXPECTED LIFT: previews build only for the current head of a ready PR, so production deploys wait behind fewer builds.

verify.cmd: node scripts/vercel-ignore-build.mjs --probe && node -e 'const m=require("fs").readFileSync("scripts/vercel-ignore-build.mjs","utf8");if(!/prs\.length === 0/.test(m)){console.error("HYG-167: a preview with no open pull request still builds");process.exit(1)}'
verify.note: The probe fails while a preview for a branch with no open pull request builds, or while a ready pull request skips its preview. Fails on main, where the no-PR rule does not exist.
